title: Take a document back off a submission

v1.description: What happens when a submitter removes a file they attached: the document answering that requirement goes, and whether anything is still missing is recorded again - taking a file back off can be the thing that makes a request incomplete, exactly as attaching one can be the thing that completes it. The whole document goes rather than its latest version: attaching twice makes a new version of the same document, which reads as a replacement, but removing says this was the wrong file altogether. Detaching is a workflow rather than a write for the same reason attaching is, and under the same rule - the person who raised the request, while it is still a draft. The start event admits everyone because the rule that matters is *the person who raised this particular submission*, which no performer can express.

mark.label: Record whether anything is still missing
